Hi all 	6 quick technical notes ahead of the call: 

- mTLS/auth: Redwood supports mTLS for Private deployments. For hosted endpoints we recommend token-based auth (API keys) over TLS. For mutual auth we can support client certs issued by your CA; we also offer an option to upload client certs to our Private control plane for verification.
- Certificate pinning: We don't require pinning on the client side; mutual TLS will validate cert chains. If you need cert pinning, we can discuss a custom option through our Private deployment contract.
- Interface endpoints: We can provide Terraform snippets for AWS Interface VPC endpoints (AWS VPCE) to reach the private control plane. The quickstart PDF includes a sample.
- IP ranges / egress: For hosted fallbacks we publish a short list of egress IPs (can be provided as a CIDR list). For Dedicated/Private, traffic stays within your VPC and uses your NAT/Egress provisioning.
- DNS: We support DNS forwarding for model selection routing; if you need private DNS zones we can configure split-horizon DNS for the VPC.

I'll bring a short checklist to the call; happy to stay on longer if NetOps wants to walk through Firewalls/ACLs and a sample flow.

Cheers,
Nikhil
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
